{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check: now 800 rows, one per patient
print(len(data_dedup))

# Correct assay_batch B values: divide by 10 (1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL)
data_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = data_dedup['biomarker_final']
data_dedup.loc[data_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Compute mean of corrected biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = data_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

print(mean_biomarker_final)"}
